resources.string: Three ways to start the server: wireless debugging below (no computer), this ADB command from a computer with the phone connected, or root on rooted devices. The server stops when the phone reboots.

1. Open Developer options and turn on Wireless debugging.\n2. Tap \"Pair device with pairing code\" — Android shows a 6-digit code and a pairing port. Enter both below and tap Pair (needed once).\n3. The wireless debugging screen also shows a connect port under \"IP address and port\" — enter it and tap Start. Azm Admin finds both ports automatically when it can, so they may already be filled in.
Last crash report — please send a screenshot of this to support
Like Shizuku: tap Pairing once and enter the code in the notification, then tap Start — the ports are found automatically. The fields below are a manual fallback.
Open "Pair device with pairing code" in Wireless debugging.
Contacting the ADB daemon with your code.
Type the 6-digit code shown in Wireless debugging.
An Azm Admin notification will help you complete pairing.
Notifications are disabled for Azm Admin. The pairing flow works through a notification, so enable notifications first.

Azm Admin needs access to the local network, controlled by the network permission. Some ROMs (such as MIUI) do not let apps reach the local network while invisible, even as a foreground service — on those, disable battery optimizations for Azm Admin.
On MIUI, also allow Azm Admin to run in the background and disable its battery restrictions, or the pairing notification and discovery may be blocked.
1 — Open Developer options → Wireless debugging, and tap "Pair device with pairing code". You will see a 6-digit code.
2 — Enter the code in the Azm Admin notification sent to you.
3 — Return to Azm Admin and tap Start.
